title: Pay-in-Full Credit on Outpatient Surgery Package Balances (Good Faith & Price Estimates)
content:
**Q. Is there a credit for paying the pre-service balance on a Riverbend Self-Pay Package Price - Outpatient Surgery booking soon after the initial deposit?**

Yes, under Good Faith & Price Estimates. The days since the initial deposit run from the posting date of the latest initial deposit collection on the estimate to today's date, the posting date not counted and today counted. A pre-service balance paid zero to seven days after the initial deposit takes off one and a half percent (1.5 percent) of the surgical package price; eight to thirty days after takes off one half of one percent (0.5 percent); later, with no initial deposit on record, or with one dated after today's date, takes off nothing. The surgical package price is the Riverbend facility line plus the Riverbend professional line carrying the principal service code on the current version.

| Days since the latest initial deposit collection | Credit taken off |
|---|---|
| 0 to 7 | 1.5 percent of the surgical package price |
| 8 to 30 | 0.5 percent of the surgical package price |
| 31 or more | nothing |
| no initial deposit collection on record | nothing |
| collection posted after today | nothing |

**Q. Which collection is read when there are several initial deposit collections?** The one with the latest posting date.

**Q. Edges?** (hypothetical, surgical package price 4000.00) 7 days after: 60.00 off. 8 days after: 20.00 off. 30 days: 20.00 off. 31 days: nothing.
